propositions: run_git_write does not retry write-side temp-file faults (ENOENT/EINVAL/insertion errors) because _with_transient_fault_retry only matched read-side signatures (HEAD parse, bad object)

event_append._git_add routes through its own private _with_transient_add_retry with the write-side markers, but s3_doctor, compaction, and claim/transition writers using run_git_write directly are unprotected against the same fault class

write-side marker family (_TRANSIENT_WRITE_MARKERS: 'unable to create temporary file', 'failed to insert into database', 'unable to index file') is duplicated between gitutil (implicit absence) and event_append, creating one definition and maintenance asymmetry
nested retry composition in event_append accidentally gives commit paths up to 3×3 attempts on write faults instead of the intended bounded 3
corrupt-object signatures ('loose object ... is corrupt', 'inflate: data stream error') must remain excluded from retry and surface immediately on all callers
